verdict.rationale: Sierra is an enterprise AI-agent platform that processes customer conversation data, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack states that customer data is excluded from model training or that users can opt out. The compliance list (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 42001, etc.) does not address training-data use, so it cannot be credited here.
